task_description: Transform the legacy desktop educational management system into a modern cloud-based SaaS platform. The new system replicates 100% of the operational logic, workflows, modules, menus, submenus, forms, fields, reports, permissions, and functional structure of the legacy system while modernizing only the visual interface. Tech stack: Node.js/Express backend, React/Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, JWT authentication. Features: multi-tenant, multi-unit, multi-user, granular permissions, complete audit logging, REST API.

verification.summary: All verification passed. Backend TypeScript compiles cleanly. Next.js frontend builds successfully with 14 routes. Prisma schema validates with 22 models. All 32 tests pass (auth: login/refresh/logout, cadastros: courses/classes/students CRUD, matriculas: full lifecycle). Tests exercise real code paths through service layer mocking.
